July 27, 2007, MAJ Tom Bostick was serving as commander of B Troop, 1st Squadron, 91st Cavalry Regiment, 173rd Airborne Brigade. He and his troops were stationed at Combat Outpost Keating in Afghanistan.Bostick was 37, of Llano, TX, with a wife and two daughters.

COP Keating was in Nuristan province, teeming with insurgents.

Bostick and the men of 1/91 CAV went to meet the villagers of a local town, Saret Koleh, on this day 13 years ago.
